rationale: Will's AI-SaaS company aiphrodite.ai and Evan's work building Expo Agent—an agentic interface for deploying apps—operate in adjacent spaces where AI tooling meets developer accessibility. Evan's expertise in React, React Native, and AI-driven tooling, combined with his track record making mobile development more accessible, could inform how aiphrodite.ai thinks about cross-platform deployment and developer experience. This is a mutual match, suggesting both could benefit from understanding each other's approach to AI-powered developer tools.
intro_message: Will Song, meet Evan Bacon — you're both building AI-driven tools for developers, and Evan's work on Expo Agent and universal code sharing could offer valuable perspective on aiphrodite.ai's platform strategy.
